headline: IDF claims Gaza City strike target was senior Hamas official Akram Bassam Shaaban Yassin
dek: The man killed with his wife in the Tuesday Gaza City apartment strike (identified by medical sources as Akram Yassin and Dina Yassin) was Akram Bassam Shaaban Yassin, a senior Hamas official responsible for protecting Hamas leadership, per IDF/Shin Bet.
sources: Israel National News tag feed carrying IDF/Shin Bet statements
fault_line: Israel says it killed a Hamas official; the family says a civilian couple — what does either side actually prove?
